_readme: THE business facts: hours, phone, address. Edit this file, then run `python3 tools/build.py`. It rewrites every hours/phone line on the site, the structured data, llms.txt and the PDF. n8n reads this file live from https://georgianbakedgoods.com/data/business.json, so online ordering opens and closes on these hours. Times are 24-hour HH:MM in Toronto time; null = closed all day. Use `specialHours` for a one-off day (holiday, closed early).
name: Georgian Baked Goods
_specialHoursFormat: Each entry: { "date": "2026-12-25", "closed": true, "note": "Christmas Day" } or { "date": "2026-12-24", "open": "11:00", "close": "16:00", "note": "Christmas Eve" }. Online ordering follows these; past dates are ignored.
